D4EB is a perspective that can help designers to design for embodied being-in-the-world.

D4EB is about designing for the body as a lived body, which is always in a relation with other lived bodies in a world.
The main takeaway from our work is that
designers should consider hybrids as tools to help people in their everyday lives, rather than as tools to help them represent and control their environment.
the designer should not aim to create a perfect fit between the hybrid and the user.
